written: 2026-11-12, before either method was run; answers checked by hand against the code at the frozen commit
match_rule: A result matches an answer when it is in the answer's file and its lines overlap the answer's span. A Python symbol's span runs from its def or class line (decorators included) to its last line, as Python's ast reports it. A bash function runs from 'name() {' to its closing '}'. Other answers state their lines and an anchor text that must be on the first of them. A question is answered at k when any of its answers matches one of the first k results.
decision_rule: Primary measure: questions answered within the top 3 results, out of 30. semble is adopted only if it answers at least 5 more questions within the top 3 than ripgrep plus pyright, and no fewer within the top 1 and within the top 5. Any other outcome: not adopted.
